rec.name: Collection Card Color Swatches (CRO | Artikel Farben)
rec.status: Built — launched (delivered 2025-04-22; documentation reviewed in May 2025)

what.text: Variant color swatches shown under the product image on each product card in collection and listing grids. Each swatch is a small thumbnail of the variant's featured image, with a colored background as a fallback. The first variant is selected by default, and a tooltip with the variant name appears on hover. Clicking a swatch swaps the card's primary image to that variant's image. Swatches can be round or square, in small, medium or large sizes. They only render for products with more than one variant. The ticket asked for the swatches to lead to the variant, but the delivered code swaps the card image and does not change the link.

why.text: Shoppers can see color options right in the grid and preview them without opening the PDP. This reduces clicks and friction, helps shoppers find the color they like faster, and makes the range feel bigger. Showing more choices on the card also lets shoppers self-select, which increases the relevance of the click to the PDP. A thumbnail of the real product in each color is more informative than an abstract color dot.

how.text: Three steps, built and tested on the Focal theme (the reference was the Eclipse theme), with a setup guide for other themes. 1) In the product-item snippet, inside the product-item__info div, add Liquid that renders a list of swatch buttons, one per variant. It is wrapped in a check for more than one variant and the theme setting being on. The markup includes the CSS for the swatch sizes, shapes, hover ring, selected ring and tooltip. Each swatch's inner span uses the variant's featured image as its background and stores a large image URL in data-background. 2) In main-collection.liquid, add a script that sets up click handlers: on click it marks the swatch as selected and swaps the src and srcset of .product-item__primary-image to the swatch's image. It re-initializes on DOMContentLoaded, on shopify:section:load in design mode, on the collection:updated event, and via a MutationObserver for AJAX-loaded products (filters, pagination). 3) In settings_schema.json, add a 'CRO | Product Colors' header with three settings: a show checkbox, a Round/Square select and a Small/Medium/Large select. Maintenance happens through variants and their variant images in the Shopify admin.

items: Show CRO Product Colors (checkbox, default on)

dependencies.text: Products need multiple variants, each with an assigned variant featured image. The ticket flags a metafield as needed, but the delivered code uses none, only variants and variant images. Written for the Focal theme: it relies on the product-item snippet and the classes .product-item__info and .product-item__primary-image, and the product-item.product-item element, so other themes need class adjustments. The swatches work only on collection and listing pages. A PDP color selector that links to separate products (as in Eclipse) is a different, metafield-based solution and is out of scope.
